applicability: Code-range display and location-group state of the mounted review page.
conditions: The code-context preference is stored under review.code-context.v1; Full context shows the whole recorded range, not a separate full-file read.
Diffs use split layout at a content width of at least 1080px and unified layout below it.
Group openings survive subject reads within the mounted page; there is no Layout selector or per-expression full-file disclosure.
exclusions: Local group openings are not persisted knowledge or cross-session preferences.
statement: Changes only is the default recorded-range view; the one Changes only/Full context control is remembered across review openings and reloads. Diff layout follows the reading column's content width, while opened location groups remain local workspace state.
